clues.text: A messenger told Daniel that Persia's prince blocked him twenty-one days, until this chief prince came to help.
Before going to fight Persia's prince, Daniel's visitor said only this one had the courage to support him.
Daniel was told this great prince, who watches over his people, will rise up in a time of unmatched distress.
Jude writes that this heavenly leader argued with the devil over who would have the body of Moses.
Jude says this archangel would not bring a slanderous charge against the devil, saying only, "The Lord rebuke you!"
In John's vision, a war broke out in heaven as this one and his angels fought the dragon.
John saw the dragon that this one fought lose its place in heaven and be hurled down to earth.
